### Custom Domain & Hosting

How It Works

## From Idea to Live Store in Four Steps


BrightDrop walks you through brand direction, storefront build, seamless payment processing setup, and a full launch with custom domain and hosting — everything you need to go live with confidence.















01







### Brand Direction


Define your digital identity. We help you shape your store's visual language, tone, and positioning so your brand stands out in a crowded marketplace from day one.










02







### Storefront Build


Your unique digital storefront takes shape — modular product pages, a bright eye-catching aesthetic, and a fast, polished layout built to convert browsers into buyers instantly.










03







### Payment Setup


Activate integrated credit card payment processing services so you can receive payments instantly. Secure checkout, multiple currencies, and instant digital delivery — all configured and ready.










04







### Launch & Go Live


Connect your custom domain, configure hosting, and hit publish. Your BrightDrop store is live, fully supported, and ready to sell digital products to the world — starting now.

Got Questions?

## Everything You Need to Know About BrightDrop


From payment processing platforms to custom domains — we've answered the most common questions so you can launch with confidence.









01

### What makes BrightDrop different from other digital stores?






BrightDrop is built from the ground up as a high-energy, creator-first digital storefront. Unlike generic platforms, we combine a striking visual identity with a complete launch toolkit — instant digital delivery, integrated payment processing services, custom domain support, and hosting guidance all in one place. You get a store that looks exclusive and works flawlessly, without cobbling together a dozen separate tools.









02

### Can I sell digital products directly through BrightDrop?






Absolutely. BrightDrop is purpose-built for selling digital goods — templates, design assets, software, courses, e-books, presets, and more. Each product listing supports instant delivery upon purchase, so your customers receive their files immediately after checkout. No manual fulfillment, no delays. Just a clean, fast buying experience that keeps customers coming back.









03

### How does payment setup work — and which payment processing platforms are supported?






Getting paid is straightforward. BrightDrop integrates with leading online payment processing companies including Stripe and PayPal, giving you access to credit card payment processing services right out of the box. Setup takes minutes — connect your account, set your prices, and you're ready to accept payments globally. We handle the technical complexity so you can focus on creating and selling.









04

### Can I use my own custom domain with BrightDrop?






Yes — your brand, your domain. BrightDrop fully supports custom domain mapping, so your store can live at yourbrand.com instead of a generic subdomain. You can connect a domain you already own or register a new one. We walk you through every DNS step with clear guidance, making the process fast even if you've never set up a domain before. A custom domain builds trust and makes your store feel truly professional.









05

### Does BrightDrop include hosting, or do I need to arrange that separately?






Hosting is fully included. Your BrightDrop store is hosted on fast, secure infrastructure — no separate hosting plan needed. We take care of uptime, performance, SSL certificates, and security so your store stays online and loads quickly for every customer. If you have questions about advanced hosting configurations or need guidance on migrating an existing store, our support team is ready to help at every step.











Still have questions?

Side-by-Side Breakdown

## Generic Setup vs. Your Branded Store


The difference between a digital presence that gets ignored and one that gets remembered comes down to ownership, trust, and professional infrastructure — all built into BrightDrop.










Generic Digital Setup





### Unnamed & Unbranded


Launching on a generic subdomain or third-party platform means your store competes on someone else's terms — with their branding, their limitations, and their rules.








#### Ownership


You don't fully own your storefront. Platform changes, policy updates, or account suspensions can wipe your business overnight.









#### Professionalism


A generic URL like yourshop.platform.com signals amateur hour. Customers hesitate before entering payment details on unfamiliar domains.









#### Memorability


Long, forgettable URLs don't stick. Word-of-mouth referrals die when customers can't recall where they bought from.









#### Customer Trust


Unbranded checkouts and shared hosting environments raise red flags. Shoppers abandon carts when they don't feel secure — even with solid payment processing services behind the scenes.






Result

Lower conversions, weaker brand recall, and a store that feels disposable.







VS







BrightDrop Branded Store





### Owned, Branded & Built to Last


BrightDrop gives you a fully custom domain, dependable hosting support, and an integrated payment processing platform — so your store is entirely yours, from the URL to the checkout.








#### Ownership


Your domain, your data, your rules. BrightDrop's custom domain and hosting support means no third-party can pull the rug out from under your business.









#### Professionalism


A clean, branded URL like yourstore.com instantly signals legitimacy. Customers arrive with confidence and leave with receipts — not doubts.









#### Memorability


Short, sharp, and searchable. A custom domain sticks in the mind, earns repeat visits, and builds organic word-of-mouth that compounds over time.









#### Customer Trust


A recognizable domain paired with secure, integrated payment processing services creates the kind of checkout experience that converts browsers into buyers — and buyers into loyal fans.






Result

Higher conversions, stronger brand equity, and a store that feels premium from first click to final download.











Ready to launch under your own domain with full hosting support?

Got Questions?

## Everything You Need to Know


Quick answers about project fit, timelines, payment processing services, and how BrightDrop's domain & hosting support works.










01


### Is BrightDrop the right fit for my digital products?


BrightDrop is built for creators, makers, and entrepreneurs selling digital goods — templates, tools, ebooks, courses, design assets, and more. If you want a polished storefront that handles everything from product listings to payment processing platforms out of the box, you're in the right place. Not sure? Reach out and we'll help you decide in minutes.









02


### How long does it take to get my store live?


Most stores go live within 24–72 hours after onboarding. We move fast. Once you share your products and branding, our team configures your storefront, sets up your payment processing services, and gets everything production-ready. Complex stores with many products or custom integrations may take a few extra days — we'll give you a clear timeline upfront.









03


### How do I set up payments and start receiving money?


We integrate with leading online payment processing companies so you can accept credit cards, debit cards, and digital wallets globally. During setup, we connect your preferred payment gateway (Stripe, PayPal, or similar), configure instant delivery triggers, and test the full checkout flow. You'll be receiving real payments from day one — no technical knowledge required on your end.









04


### Can I use my own domain and what about hosting?


Absolutely. BrightDrop supports full custom domain integration — bring your own domain or we'll help you register one. Hosting is fully managed on our end: fast, secure, and optimized for digital product delivery. You own your brand, your domain, and your store. We handle the infrastructure so you can focus on creating and selling.














Still have a question we didn't cover?

# Return Policy


Last Updated: 5/27/2026



At BrightDrop, we want you to be satisfied with your purchase. This policy outlines your rights for returns and refunds.


## 1. Return Window


You may return most items within 30 days of delivery for a full refund.


- Items must be unused and in original condition

- Items must be in original packaging

- Receipt or proof of purchase required




## 2. Non-Returnable Items


- Perishable goods

- Custom or personalized items

- Digital products and opened software

- Personal hygiene products that have been opened




## 3. Damaged or Defective Items


If you receive a damaged or defective item, contact us within 48 hours for a full refund including shipping costs.


## 4. Contact Us



For returns or questions:


Email: nruckerbiz2026@gmail.com


Phone: 17065802483


Address: PO Box 106, Geneva, Georgia, 31810, United States



### Business Hours


- Monday: 06:00 - 06:00

- Tuesday: 06:00 - 06:00

- Wednesday: 06:00 - 06:00

- Thursday: 06:00 - 06:00

- Friday: 06:00 - 06:00

- Saturday: 06:00 - 06:00

- Sunday: Closed

# Privacy Policy



Last Updated:  5/27/2026



BrightDrop ("Company", "we", "our") is committed to protecting your privacy. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use and protect your information when you use our website [business_website] ("Service").


## 1. Information Collection


We may collect the following types of information:


- Personal Information: Name, email address, phone number and address

- Technical Information: IP address, browser type, operating system and website usage data

- Cookies: Information stored on your computer to improve user experience




## 2. Use of Information


We use the collected information for the following purposes:


- Providing requested services

- Improving service and user experience

- Contacting you regarding our services

- Compliance with legal requirements




## 3. Information Sharing


We do not sell, rent or share your personal information with third parties, except in the following cases:


- With your explicit consent

- When required by law

- To protect our rights or user safety

- With service providers who assist in operating the service (under confidentiality agreements)




## 4. User Rights


In accordance with Israeli Privacy Protection Law 1981, you have the following rights:


- Right to access personal information stored about you

- Right to correct inaccurate or incomplete information

- Right to delete personal information in certain circumstances

- Right to object to information processing for marketing purposes

- Right to file a complaint with the Data Protection Authority




## 5. Cookies


Our website uses cookies to improve user experience. You can manage cookies through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect website functionality.


## 6. Information Security


We implement reasonable security measures to protect your information, including encryption, firewalls and restricted access control. However, no transmission or storage method is 100% secure.


## 7. Policy Changes


We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Material changes will be posted on the website with 30 days advance notice.



## 8. Contact Information


For questions or requests regarding this privacy policy, please contact us:


- Company: BrightDrop

- Email: nruckerbiz2026@gmail.com

- Phone: 17065802483

- Address: PO Box 106, Geneva, Georgia, 31810, United States



Data Protection Authority: For complaints, you may contact the Data Protection Authority at the Ministry of Justice

# Accessibility Statement



Last updated:  May 27, 2026



BrightDrop is committed to making our services accessible to all users. We strive to implement the Israeli Standard (TI 5568) based on WCAG 2.1 Level AA guidelines.


Accessibility Level: AA (Israeli Standard TI 5568)



## 1. Accessibility Policy


We believe in equal rights and the right of every person to receive information and services independently and equally. This website was designed and built with special emphasis on accessibility for people with disabilities.


## 2. Accessibility Arrangements on the Site


- Keyboard navigation support

- Screen reader compatibility

- Appropriate color contrast

- Flexible and scalable font sizes

- Descriptive image alt text

- Hierarchical heading structure

- Clear and descriptive links

- Support for 200% zoom without content loss





### WCAG 2.1 Compliance


The website complies with WCAG 2.1 Level AA, which includes:


- Perceivable: Information is presented in ways users can perceive

- Operable: Interface components are operable

- Understandable: Information and user interface are understandable

- Robust: Content can be interpreted by a variety of technologies





## 3. Supported Assistive Technologies


- NVDA (Windows)

- JAWS (Windows)

- VoiceOver (Mac/iOS)

- TalkBack (Android)

- Dragon NaturallySpeaking

- Switch navigation




## 4. Accessibility Testing


The website has been tested using:


- Automated accessibility testing tools

- Manual testing with screen readers

- Keyboard-only navigation

- Color contrast verification

- Testing with users with disabilities




## 5. Continuous Improvements


We are continuously working to improve the accessibility of our website and update it according to technological developments and user feedback.



## 6. Contact and Feedback


If you encounter an accessibility issue on the site or need assistance, please contact us:


- Company: BrightDrop

- Email: nruckerbiz2026@gmail.com

- Phone: 17065802483



Response time: We respond to accessibility inquiries within 3 business days and work to resolve issues within 10 business days.

# Terms of Use



Last updated:  May 27, 2026



Use of this site constitutes agreement to the terms outlined below. Please read carefully before use.



## 1. Definitions


- "Company" - BrightDrop

- "User" - Anyone who browses or uses the site

- "Services" - E-commerce provided through the site




## 2. Description of Services


BrightDrop provides E-commerce through the site. The services are subject to the terms detailed in this document and may change from time to time.


## 3. Terms of Use


Use of the site is conditional on compliance with the following terms:


- Use of the site for lawful purposes only

- No interference with site operations or other users

- No uploading of offensive, illegal, or harmful content

- Respect for copyright and intellectual property rights

- No actions that may compromise site security




## 4. User Obligations


- Providing accurate and truthful information during registration or ordering

- Maintaining confidentiality of account access details

- Immediate notification of any unauthorized account use

- Updating personal information as needed




## 5. Payment and Refund Policy


If services include payment:


- Payments are processed through secure and encrypted systems

- Prices include applicable taxes as required by law

- Right to cancel will be in accordance with consumer protection laws

- Refunds will be processed within 14 business days of cancellation approval




## 6. Limitation of Liability


Services are provided "as is" without warranty of any kind. The Company will not be liable for indirect, consequential, or special damages arising from use of the site, except where required by law.


## 7. Copyright and Intellectual Property


All content on the site, including text, images, design, and code, is protected by copyright owned by BrightDrop. Reproduction, distribution, or commercial use of content is prohibited without written permission.


## 8. Privacy


Collection and use of personal information is subject to our Privacy Policy. Use of the site constitutes agreement to the Privacy Policy as detailed separately.


## 9. Changes to Terms of Use


The Company may change these terms of use at any time. Material changes will be posted on the site with 30 days advance notice. Continued use after changes constitutes agreement to the new terms.


## 10. Service Termination


The Company may suspend or limit service at any time, including in cases of terms of use violations. In case of service termination, relevant provisions will remain in effect.


## 11. Governing Law and Dispute Resolution


These terms of use are governed by applicable laws. Any disputes will be resolved in accordance with local jurisdiction, with preference given to arbitration or mediation where possible.


## 12. General Provisions


- If any portion of the terms is found invalid, remaining terms will remain in effect

- Non-enforcement of a right will not be considered a waiver

- These terms of use constitute the entire agreement between the parties





## 13. Contact Information


For questions or clarifications regarding the terms of use:


- Company: BrightDrop

- Email: nruckerbiz2026@gmail.com

- Phone: 17065802483
